input.overview: Iron Maiden qualifies three-ball Multiball by completing I-R-O-N M-A-I-D-E-N and trapping all three balls in the upper walker; when both conditions are met, the walker releases them. The two five-target banks also reward order: ascending completion lights Extra Ball on the opposite level, descending completion lights Special, and another order raises Bonus X. The three-target bank awards 5 to 25 seconds of Bonus Time according to completion speed. During Bonus Time, Multiball pauses the countdown.
input.simpleOverview: Complete I-R-O-N M-A-I-D-E-N and trap all three balls in the upper walker to start three-ball Multiball. Complete a five-target bank in ascending order to light Extra Ball or descending order to light Special. Clear the three-target bank quickly for up to 25 seconds of Bonus Time.
input.summary: Spell the title while feeding balls into the walker, then use the released three-ball play to finish ordered banks. Build Bonus Time before Multiball when possible because its countdown pauses while multiple balls remain active.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Trap all three balls in the walker after the title is complete.

quickInfo.name: Light Extra Ball
quickInfo.summary: Complete a five-target bank in ascending order.

steps.text: Complete I-R-O-N M-A-I-D-E-N through the I/N lanes, O-D-E targets, and remaining lit letter switches.
Open a walker gate through the upper playfield or the right-side gate, then send a ball into the walker; repeat until all three balls are trapped.
With the title complete and three balls trapped, collect the release for three-ball Multiball.
During Multiball, work an ordered five-target bank and shoot the lower-right Spot IRON / Spot MAIDEN target when Extra Ball is lit.

alternatives.title: Bonus Time route
alternatives.when: Use this before the walker is ready or when the three-target bank is returning safely.

steps.text: Clear the three-target bank as quickly as possible for 5 to 25 seconds of Bonus Time.
Start Multiball during Bonus Time to pause the countdown while more than one ball is active.
Complete a five-target bank in ascending order to light Extra Ball on the opposite playfield level.
Complete a bank in descending order to light Special, or use the non-ordered completion to raise Bonus X.

machineSetup: Test every I-R-O-N M-A-I-D-E-N letter switch, both walker gates and all three walker positions, the three-ball release, both five-target banks, the three-target bank, and the upper and lower flippers.
Verify ascending, descending, and Bonus X bank orders; test the Bonus Time timer and confirm that Multiball pauses it and that another ball serves if all balls drain before time expires.

playfieldReferences.label: Upper walker lock
playfieldReferences.description: Three-ball storage mechanism that releases Multiball after the title is complete.

playfieldReferences.label: Ordered five-target banks
playfieldReferences.description: Banks that light Extra Ball, Special, or raise Bonus X according to order.

playfieldReferences.label: Bonus Time bank
playfieldReferences.description: Bank that awards 5 to 25 seconds according to completion speed.

playfieldReferences.label: Lower-right letter target
playfieldReferences.description: Target that can collect the lit Extra Ball during Multiball.

cautions.issue: This is Stern Electronics' 1981 Iron Maiden, not Stern's 2018 Iron Maiden: Legacy of the Beast.
cautions.response: Use the walker, ordered drop banks, and Bonus Time rules only for the vintage split-level machine.
